Download directories from another projr analysis

Source: R/get.R
projr_get.Rd

Copy whole directories from a completed build into out/<label>/. projr verifies each file against the build manifest before installing any of the selected directories.

Usage

projr_get(type, ...)

projr_get_local(
  path = NULL,
  remote = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  out = ".",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

projr_get_github(
  repo = NULL,
  remote = NULL,
  tag = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  out = ".",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

type

A source type, "local" or "github".

...

Arguments for projr_get_local() or projr_get_github().

path

Path to the local analysis that produced the files.

remote

Title of a remote in the current project's configuration. Supply exactly one of this title and the direct source (path or repo).

label

Directory labels to copy. By default, copy the labels recorded for the selected build at the source.

version

Exact build version, with or without a leading v. Defaults to the producer's completed build or the release's recorded project version.

out

Directory to receive a subdirectory for each label.

overwrite

Allow replacement of changed or extra files in the selected output directories. Matching files can be reused with either setting.

repo

A producing GitHub project in owner/repo or owner/repo@branch form. Without a branch, use its default branch.

tag

Concrete GitHub release tag. With a direct repository, a tag identifies the release without looking up the producer's configuration.

Value

A named character vector of absolute paths to the verified directories.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
projr_get_local(path = "../analysis", label = "output", out = "downloads")
projr_get_github(repo = "owner/analysis@main", label = "raw-data")
projr_get("github", remote = "reports", version = "1.2.0", out = "downloads")
} # }
